quote: We evaluate clustering results with several standard metrics. ( ) ARI (Hubert and Arabie, 1985) measures the similarity between two cluster assignments based on the number of pairs in the same/different clusters. (2) NMI denotes the normalized mutual information between two cluster assignments. (3) BCubed-F1 estimates the quality of the generated cluster assignment by aggregating the precision and recall of each element. (4) ACC measures the clustering quality by finding the permutation function from predicted cluster IDs to ground truth IDs that gives the highest accuracy.
